idea: A massive, tightly stacked serif carries the cover; one orange sun is the only image.
name: The Grid
Brand Name
idea: The author's name is the biggest thing on the cover, like an established bestseller; hard black-and-white photo.
The photo is cropped to a thin horizon strip across the middle; the rest is quiet paper and a calm serif.
name: Horizon Band
Up the Spine
idea: The title runs vertically up the left edge in towering condensed caps; a narrow right column holds a red square and the author.

name: Arch Window
idea: A duotone portrait seen through a chapel-window arch with a hairline frame; an italic serif title sits below like a caption.

name: Color Field
idea: Two soft-edged painted fields stack like an abstract canvas; the title is set small and wide on the bare margin below.

name: The Band
idea: A solid band of deep color slices across a toned landscape and carries the title in reversed Bodoni.

name: The Thread
idea: A single red thread drops from the top edge to a tiny knot, and the title hangs from it in open space.
The title is struck once in full ink, then repeats down the cover in ever fainter impressions, like a sound dying away.
name: Echo

idea: The portrait survives only as a narrow vertical slice; a tall stacked Caslon title holds the open left side.
name: Sliver
Snapshot
idea: A small bordered family print lies on linen like a photo found in a drawer; a long italic title reads as its caption.
A full-bleed black-and-white face fills the cover; the title is one quiet serif line at its foot, with a single spot of color above it.
name: Close
Top Half
idea: A sepia photograph fills the top half and a clean page the bottom, split by a single line of color, like an album leaf.

name: Eyes
idea: The portrait is cropped to a letterbox of the eyes alone, a gaze held between title and author.

name: Quiet
idea: A lowercase italic title rests at the optical center of warm paper, with one short hairline and nothing else: a whisper of a cover.
The cover is a typed manuscript page with a red margin line; the title sits where the first lines would be.
name: Typewritten

idea: A small oval portrait ringed in a gold hairline sits high on a deep ground, kept like a locket; classical capitals below.
name: Locket

idea: A voice-driven memoir: the heavy serif title shouts across a saturated ground, and the author's name is stamped in a black band.
name: Say It Loud
One Word
idea: A big-idea book sold on one word: the title runs edge to edge in condensed black caps on a loud, flat ground.
One bold band of color climbs across the cover like a growth chart; heavy sans title stacked hard to the top left.
name: Rising Line
Divided Mind
idea: A hard black-and-white face is split down the middle by a solid column of color that carries the title: two selves, one cover.

name: Deep Field
idea: The universe runs full bleed and a wide display title floats in its darkest sky, like a narrative science bestseller.

name: Museum Plate
idea: The image hangs in a hairline frame like an archive print, with engraved capitals above and an italic caption below.
A field of survey contour lines with one small summit marker; the title is cut into a solid block like an expedition stamp.
name: Contour

idea: A self-help promise set huge and stacked on a white card, laid on a cheerful flat ground like a note to yourself.
name: The Card
Dawn
idea: A half sun rises from the bottom edge into a soft morning gradient, beneath a calm lowercase serif title.
A calm landscape runs full bleed and the title sits on a plain paper card pinned to its lower left, like a note left on the view.
name: Field Note

idea: A classified page where every line is blacked out except the title, with a red stamp struck across the bars.
name: Redacted
Window Grid
idea: The city glows through the mullions of a high-rise window; the title sits on the dark sill beneath.

name: The Slit
idea: The photo is cut down to a single letterbox band across a dark field, like a view through a mail slot.

name: Spine Line
idea: The title is set vertically up the left edge like a spine; the photo fills the rest behind one hard accent cut.
The title repeats down the cover like an echo, fading in and out; only the middle line burns in full color.
name: Echo
The Cut
idea: A slab of hazard color slices diagonally across a black-and-white photo; the title rides the cut.

name: Hard Border
idea: The stacked title is set so big it bleeds off the right edge of the cover; one accent bar is the only other mark.
The photo is framed as a CCTV feed: viewfinder brackets, a red recording dot, and the title as the evidence beneath.
name: Surveillance
Keyhole
idea: A golden-age detective cover: warm light pours through a single keyhole in a dark lacquered door.

name: Deco Arch
idea: A 1930s travel-poster arch frames a sepia photograph, as if the murder happened on holiday.
Domestic suspense: a black house against a dusk sky, and only one window is awake.
name: One Lit Window
Pale Portrait
idea: Domestic suspense: a washed-out portrait and a calm serif title, with one red underline as the only wrong note.

name: Venetian Blinds
idea: Noir: hard light falls through venetian blinds across a black-and-white photo; one lipstick-red name.
Noir: a single streetlamp throws a cone of light into the dark, and the title stands inside it.
name: Under the Lamp

idea: A golden-age country-house mystery: a fine-line floor plan of the rooms, and a red X where the body lies.
name: Floor Plan

idea: Nordic mystery: a cold photo whose highlights melt into a snow-white field, with one tiny red figure on the horizon.
name: White Horizon
Ajar
idea: A door stands open a crack in total darkness; the photo shows only through that sliver of light.
Two small eyes open in a vast, empty black; the restraint is the scare.
name: Unblinking

idea: Folk horror: a midsummer eclipse, one black disc ringed in red on a bone-pale ground.
name: Black Sun

idea: A haunted portrait drowned in a single color; the title is a small italic whisper beneath it.
name: Her Likeness
The Drip
idea: Visceral with restraint: one thin red drip runs from the black title down an otherwise clean white cover.

name: The Still Lake
idea: The title sits on a black waterline, and its reflection hangs upside down beneath it, wrong in a way you notice slowly.
Three clean cuts tear diagonally through a huge title like claw marks; violence implied, never shown.
name: Claw Marks

idea: One old snapshot hangs alone on a stained wall, with a handwritten caption no one should have written.
name: Found Photograph

idea: A slender blade pierces a thin gold ring: love and violence in one romantasy emblem, floating in smoke.
name: Blade & Ring

idea: A duotone portrait glows through a tall arch window, its edge echoed by a hairline of gold, like a fae court's doorway.
name: Ember Arch
Venn
idea: Two flat circles drift into each other; where they overlap a third color appears, which is the whole rom-com in one diagram.
The photo is a holiday postcard with rounded corners and a stamped postmark ring; a chunky soft serif title sits above like handwriting on the back.
name: Postcard

idea: A portrait set like a Regency cameo: an oval crop in a hairline gold ring, with a swooning italic title beneath.
name: Cameo
Silk Hem
idea: A painted portrait fills the top two-thirds; a solid band of jewel-toned silk, edged with a gold trim line, carries the type like a gown's hem.

name: Slash
idea: A single blood-red hairline slices diagonally across a stacked high-contrast serif title on near-black; nothing else.
The photo is only glimpsed through a narrow vertical slit in black, like a door left ajar; the title is laid across it in white.
name: Slit

idea: A loose wet-in-wet wash of field colors blooms over the top half and fades into cream paper, where a soft serif title waits.
name: Wildflower Wash

idea: A striped shop awning with a scalloped edge crowns the cover, so the whole book becomes the shopfront; a warm soft serif title stacks below.
name: Awning

idea: A round lens and a stout handle turn the photo into a view through a detective's magnifying glass, set on a quiet flat ground.
name: Magnifier
Jam Label
idea: The cover is a jar of preserves: a cream oval label with a fine inner line sits on gingham, and the title is lettered on it like a homemade label.
Split like a seed packet: a tall rounded panel of garden painting on the right, the title stacked down a quiet cream column on the left.
name: Garden Panel

idea: A hearth arch drawn in one warm line holds a tiny two-tone flame, its glow and a few drifting sparks the only light on a dark ground.
name: Hearth

idea: A landscape in a soft two-color duotone is matted and hairline-framed like a print hung in a cottage, the title lettered on the mat above.
name: Framed Print
Crescent
idea: A crescent moon is cut from two overlapping circles above a soft, lowercase title, like a witch's shop sign at dusk.
The title is painted on a cream shop sign hung by two chains against dark wood, with the author on a smaller sign swinging beneath it.
name: Hanging Sign

idea: A photo flooded with one neon duotone; the title is set so large it bleeds off both edges of the cover.
name: Bleed

idea: A huge circle of deep space is punched out of a loud flat color and circled by a single tilted orbit line; lowercase title below.
name: Orbit
Echo
idea: The title is set three times down the cover, fading up from a whisper to full volume, a typographic crescendo.
A tilted slab of flat color slices across a duotone photo, and the title rides its eight-degree angle, off balance and urgent.
name: Tilt
Polaroid
idea: One instant photo taped to a flat color wall, with the title scrawled in marker across its bottom edge as if someone wrote on it.

name: Blood Moon
idea: A flat red moon rises behind one razor-sharp mountain silhouette; vast dark space, and a carved title on the ground below.

name: Sliver
idea: The photo is cut down to a thin eye-line band across black, like a redacted file, with a towering condensed title below.
A sunset gradient, a flat sun half-sunk below a hard horizon line, and three fading reflections on the water; the title hangs in the sky.
name: Horizon
Sword in the Ring
idea: A single gold emblem, a blade driven through a ring, glows in the dark like a sigil stamped on a war banner.
A vellum band sits over the painted land like the title plate of an old atlas, split from the world by one hard line.
name: Atlas Plate

idea: The world is glimpsed through a single gold-lined arch, a doorway the reader is invited to step through.
name: The Gate

idea: The heroine looks out of an enchanted hand mirror, the whole cover drawn as a single object on a pale ground.
name: Hand Mirror

idea: A fairytale forest cut from two layers of paper triangles, with one red moon caught in the branches.
name: Cut-Paper Wood
Library Binding
idea: A cloth-bound book with a tiny gilt key at its center: the smallest object promising the largest secret.
Only the eyes survive: the portrait is cut to a blood-washed slit across a black cover.
name: The Slit
Blood Diamond
idea: A blackletter title sealed inside a red lozenge, like a warning painted on a plague door.
A black sun ringed by a hairline corona hangs over a darkened land; nothing else is needed.
name: Eclipse
Orbital Diagram
idea: The cover is a scientific figure: hairline orbits around a star, and one red world the story happens on.
Half the cover is pure vacuum; the other half is the curve of a world, with wide type floating in the silence between.
name: Planet Limb
Carrier Wave
idea: A single signal pulses up from the bottom edge in fading rings toward a giant condensed title.
Three gold chevrons, the rank stripes of a fleet, stand alone against the galaxy like a uniform patch.
name: Rank Insignia
Signal Block
idea: A hard duotone portrait is cut off at the chest by a slab of signal color, and the title is printed straight onto the slab.
A planet too big for the cover rises in the dark, lit on one thin edge and crossed by the hairline of its ring.
name: Ringed Crescent
Misregistered
idea: The title is printed twice, a hair out of register, so the near future feels like a signal that won't quite hold still.
One small glowing screen in a vast quiet field: the only face left is the one inside the device.
name: Lit Screen
Censored Print
idea: A sepia photograph mounted on worn paper, cleared for release by a crooked red censor's stamp.
Two pale searchlight beams cross over a blacked-out city, sweeping straight through a towering title.
name: Searchlights

idea: A striped medal ribbon runs the full height, dividing a stacked title column from a soldier's quiet face.
name: Ribbon
Deco Window
idea: A black arched window set into a gilded sunburst, the title glowing inside it like a ballroom marquee.
The cover is a private letter: an italic title written on cream paper, closed with one red wax seal.
name: Sealing Wax
Gallery Plaque
idea: The heroine hangs in a gilt frame like a museum portrait, named on a small engraved plaque.

name: Saga Lintel
idea: One enormous word spans the sky like a carved lintel over generations of land; a deep band below carries the family name.
A pale sky over a deep sea with one tiny ship on the horizon: a generation's voyage reduced to a single line.
name: The Crossing
